text:
Ava: Quick sync — we need to lock the benchmark narrative and final chart set for the launch post + webinar. Can we pick visuals that map cleanly to inbound routing segments?
Diego: +1. My top priority is clarity for engineer buyers vs PM/biz buyers.
Riya: For messaging, suggest separating 'latency-sensitive' and 'cost-sensitive' use cases rather than SMB/enterprise only.
Sam: Good call. For webinar registration form we can add a required field: 'primary constraint: latency / cost / compliance' to route leads.
Ava: Love that. Chart ideas: 1) scatter of p95 latency vs $/k tokens, 2) stacked area for monthly spend by throughput profile, 3) microbench timeline showing tokens/sec across quantized variants. Thoughts?
Marcel: Scatter is good for the narrative. I can generate a clean SVG. Need to decide axes: x=cost-per-1k-tokens (USD), y=p95-ms. Also include colored markers for model family (open, optimized).
Diego: Can we make a companion chart showing 'cost per completed session' (simulate typical prompt lengths) — that resonates with product teams.
Riya: Yes — take 3 session templates (short Q/A, summarization, code-gen) and show per-session $ impact. Call it "Spend per user session".
Sam: For the launch post hero we should use the scatter + a one-liner: "Make latency predictable, keep costs in check." Then CTA to webinar sign-up.
Ava: Copy draft idea: "Benchmarks that map tokens to dollars — and the routing levers to get both low latency and low cost in production." Keep it punchy.
Diego: Small ask — add an inset showing fallback policy effect: when fast model is saturated, cost goes up but latency stays bounded. A shaded region is fine.
Marcel: I can create a 2-panel figure: left scatter, right stacked per-session bars with fallback overlay. Will export PNG + SVG.
Riya: Inbound routing: if someone picks 'latency' route to webinar nurture focusing on Dedicated + SLA content. If 'cost' route them to a short demo on Optimize tooling and batching. 
Sam: We'll set up two nurture tracks in Growth. Proposed flows:
- latency -> dedicated case studies + invite to private demo request
- cost -> Optimize tipsheet + 15-min office hours sign-up
Ava: For registrants from enterprise domains, add 'request dedicated trial' as an extra CTA.
Diego: A/B test names for webinar: "Serving Economics: Latency vs Cost in Production" vs "Tokens to Dollars: Real benchmarks for serving LLMs". Leaning to the second for click-through.
Riya: Second is clearer for non-engineer buyers. Maybe use second for paid channels, first for technical lists.
Ava: Timeline: visuals done by Marcel by Tue EOD, copy v1 by Wed, landing + routing live Thu, webinar registration open Fri. Is that realistic?
Marcel: Tue EOD OK. Will push assets to `gs://marketing-assets/bench-visuals/` and ping when ready.
Sam: Growth will create two nurture journeys and implement routing rules in HubSpot by Thu morning.
Diego: Quick note on metrics: track CTR on hero, % choose latency vs cost on form, webinar conversion, MQL->SQL by segment.
Riya: Also set up qualitative feedback capture in the webinar (poll: which constraint matters most?).
Ava: Ops-bot, create a reminder for assets review on Tue 10am.
ops-bot: Reminder created: #marketing review — Tue 10:00 — agenda: visuals + copy check.
Sam: Small implementation detail for routing (tech): HubSpot will set `lead_profile.primary_constraint` and we use that to tag leads. Diego/Marcel can share data schema if needed.
Marcel: Sharing sample schema now: `lead_profile: {primary_constraint: string, avg_session_tokens: int, company_size_bracket: string}` — I'll post the JSON in the design doc.
Diego: One more ask: include a short "how to read this chart" caption under the scatter — engineers skim visuals fast, PMs need the takeaways spelled out.
Ava: Good. Assignments: Marcel = visuals + caption, Diego = session-cost simulations, Riya = messaging + landing copy, Sam = routing + nurture setup, Ava = webinar script + hero copy. We'll reconvene Tue 10 after Marcel's drop.
Riya: Noted. I'll draft two headline variants and 3 CTAs.
Diego: Will run session sims and drop numbers by EOD Mon.
Marcel: Uploading first pass now (in progress).
Ava: Thanks team — short and focused. :rocket:
